claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 both clearly show 'Nikon' logo and 'D7100' label on the body and on the box; no Canon branding anywhere.

claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine
claims.evidence: No power-on, shutter-fire, AF, or LCD function shown in either photo; functionality cannot be assessed from static body shots.
No batteries visible in either photo; only the body and its box are shown.
No case visible in either photo; camera is shown bare without any case or wrap.

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's stated brand (Canon) and actual item (Nikon D7100) suggests a copy-pasted or mismatched listing, or deliberate misrepresentation.
risks.proof: A fresh photo/video of the camera with seller holding today's date note, confirming brand and model matches what's being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Treat as high fraud risk; do not price until identity is reconciled.

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count unknown, affects mechanical wear and price tier.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or third-party shutter-count software/website.

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, fungus, scratches) not visible without lens mounted.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sensor with light shone through the open mount.

risks.risk: Core functionality (autofocus, buttons, dials, shutter) unverified.
risks.proof: Short video of camera powering on, firing shutter, and cycling through AF/menu functions.

risks.risk: LCD screen condition unseen in any photo.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear LCD screen powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cracked/damaged screen until shown intact.

risks.risk: Lens mount pins and mirror box may have physical damage not visible in given angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of lens mount pins and mirror assembly from multiple angles.

risks.risk: No lens included in sale, only body shown.
risks.proof: Confirmation photo showing any lens included, if applicable.

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (batteries, case) not visible in any photo.
risks.proof: Photo showing the 2 batteries and silicone case alongside the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only, no accessories included.

proof_requests: Clear photo of camera and box together with brand/model clearly legible, to resolve the Canon vs Nikon discrepancy.
Video of camera powering on and firing the shutter.
Shutter count screenshot from menu or software.
Photo of sensor with lens removed and light shone in.
Photo of LCD screen powered on.
Photo showing the 2 batteries and silicone case next to the camera.
response.reason: The seller's claim that the brand is Canon directly contradicts the witness report, which clearly shows Nikon D7100 branding on both the body and box, raising serious doubt about the listing's honesty.
